Aaja Asghar veer na shaama pai gaiyan
Pyaasa Teriyan Ghazi Nu kho ke le Gaiyan
Zainab Di koi peshi na Jaway
Pal pal yaad Abbas di aaway
Behna Rondiyan pit Diyan, Haaye rahe gaiyan
Laash ghazidi khaimay nahi
Kon sunay Zainab Di dua hu
Saade sir Diyan chadaran sir toh le gaiyan
Veeran Nu phirey lab di Sakina
Aagaya vekh ke Shimr kamina
Tenu aa mila saariyan aa sa kehgaiyan

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/aaja-asghar-veer-na-shaama-pai-gaiyan.md'
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + p], text=True).split('---', 2)[2].split()
current = Path(p).read_text()
_, metadata, body = current.split('---', 2)
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
assert [word.lower() for word in roman.split() if not word.isdecimal()] == [word.lower() for word in original]
for version, digits in [(roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')]:
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in version.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [len(block) for block in blocks] == [2, 4, 4, 4]
    assert [block[0].strip() for block in blocks[1:]] == list(digits)
assert '\\u200c' not in body
PY

item.text:
Reconstructed all 11 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. The grammar supports Punjabi metadata. Both editions align across the two-line opening and three numbered stanzas.

The final line’s ambiguous `aa sa` is rendered as `آ سا`. Only the selected lyric was edited.
